name: Miriam Fenwick
source_profile:
Countess Miriam Fenwick, House Fenwick 
A shrewd administrator from a family of shipwrights and harbor officials, Miriam distinguished 
herself by keeping vital ports open to royalist shipping during the war. Her appointment was 
welcomed by wealthy merchants but resented by many veteran sailors who served under the 
former earl. She is practical, business-minded, and determined to restore Ballantyre's battered 
maritime economy. 
The Earldom of Galrothe 
Prosperous towns, cavalry traditions, and divided loyalties.
